name: Truc Lam Zen Monastery
summary: Ride the cable car from Robin Hill, then walk the gardens and halls of Truc Lam Zen Monastery on Phoenix Hill, looking down over Tuyen Lam Lake. Allow 1 to 2 hours with the ride, and dress modestly for the halls.
fee: Free; cable car Check on arrival
heroCaption: The monastery hall at Truc Lam

notice.title: The cable car is a separate fare
notice.body: The monastery is free. The cable car is priced on its own. Wear modest clothing.

body: Truc Lam sits on Phoenix Hill, also called Phuong Hoang Hill, above Tuyen Lam Lake. The gardens and the view down to the reservoir are the visit. Wear modest clothing for the halls.
Arrive by the cable car from Robin Hill on a clear morning for the lake view. The monastery is free; allow 1 to 2 hours including the ride.

figures.caption: The monastery gate above the lake
figures.alt: Gate at Truc Lam Zen Monastery, looking toward the water

gettingThere: The monastery is south of town on Phoenix Hill. Take a taxi from Xuan Huong Lake to the Robin Hill station, then the cable car.

legs.heading: From Xuan Huong Lake
legs.body: Taxi to the Robin Hill cable station, then the car.

admissionNote: Monastery: free (Visit Lâm Đồng). Cable car: Check on arrival; Dalattourist prints about 120,000 VND one way for an adult. Monastery hours are Check on arrival.
